WidgetWorld specialises in the manufacture and distribution of precision industrial widgets.
Our products are used across 40 countries in automotive, aerospace, and construction industries.

We have been producing high-quality widgets since 1987, with over 200 product lines and 3,000 clients worldwide.
Our manufacturing plants are located in Germany, Poland, and the Czech Republic.
